'''2011 Worlds Day 2 David Mearns LS Quiet Mining Colony''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[David Mearns]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Kannon Shev-us QMC'''. Transcription notes: Line 20 written ''Oumler/Qymler (one word, unread)''; Line 28 written ''EP1 Obi Wan''. Lines shown in italics are as written on the sheet and are not linked because the card could not be identified for certain.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Quiet Mining Colony / Independent Operation|Quiet Mining Colony]]
* '''Username:''' Darklad075
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
